decoding.system:
You are the intake brain for a voice agent at Northgate Health. You receive one caller turn at a time.

Reply with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else — no prose, no code fence:
{"route": "<route>", "slots": {"<key>": "<value>", ...}, "reply": "<one or two sentences you would say back>"}

route must be exactly one of: book_appointment, reschedule_appointment, cancel_appointment, billing_question, update_contact_details, prescription_refill, escalate_to_human, other
slots keys may only be: caller_name, member_id, date, amount, phone

Rules for slots:
- Include a slot ONLY if the caller actually said its value in this call.
- Never guess, never complete a partial value, never carry a value over from your own general knowledge. An omitted slot is always better than an invented one.
- member_id, phone: digits only, no spaces or punctuation.
- amount: a plain decimal number, no currency symbol (e.g. 142.50).
- date: lowercase month name and day number (e.g. march 14).
- caller_name: exactly as the caller gave it.

arms.label: A — metadata off
arms.description: The brain sees the ASR transcript and nothing else. This is also, exactly, what the live voice path does today: production STT routes to AssemblyAI/Sarvam/Deepgram, none of which emit a metadata head.

arms.label: B — metadata present (cascade output, production format)
arms.description: The transcript, preceded by the real whissle-large metadata head's output for the same audio, rendered by production's own formatter. NOT a reconstruction of the signal — the signal itself, obtained from the batch path, which is the only place the head is currently reachable.

preflight.note: Availability below 1.0 is the production behaviour of /api/models/transcribe: the whissle-large metadata head is called in parallel and fails open on timeout, so the `metadata` key is simply absent. The ablation retries per case to obtain it.

metadata_head.note: First-attempt availability is what an ordinary caller of /api/models/transcribe experiences. The suite retries to obtain the metadata; the retries change nothing about the audio or transcript.

asr_cascade.note: A property of the ear, measured once, identical for both arms. It bounds what any entity consumption could achieve: a value the ear never heard cannot be filled correctly downstream.

results.note: every pair was identical — the arms produced the same value on every case

channels.summary: Produced by the whissle-large metadata head; injected into the prompt inside the [User speech analysis: …] developer message. Reaches the model — but only when the head is serving, which on the live voice path it is not.
Produced and injected alongside emotion. NOT read by the flow engine: transitions are decided by expression evaluation and an LLM condition judge, never by the ASR intent head.

Requested from the ASR as a metadata tag and then dropped: `entity` is not in _METADATA_FIELDS, so it never reaches the prompt, and nothing in services/flow/ reads it, so it never reaches a slot. Slots are filled by a separate LLM extraction pass over the transcript (flow/collector.py), which is text-only. The entity channel currently contributes nothing to anything.
Produced by the same head and never injected — not in _METADATA_FIELDS.
Produced by the same head and never injected — not in _METADATA_FIELDS.

Computed from the metadata probability timeline and emitted to the client only. Phase 1 is produce-and-record: it is never placed in the prompt, so it cannot change a reply. It also depends on the same head, so with the head off it computes over an empty timeline.
Shadow draft / predicted tools sit behind SHADOW_LLM and SHADOW_LLM_DRAFT, both defaulting off.
Speculative tool pre-warm sits behind SPECULATIVE_TOOLS, defaulting off.

live_voice_path.claim: On the live voice path the metadata head is not running. Production STT is routed to AssemblyAI (English/Hinglish), Sarvam (Indian languages) or Deepgram; none of them emit a metadata head. The whissle-large sidecar that would supply one is gated behind WHISSLE_STT_TRANSPORT=grpc plus WHISSLE_GRPC_TARGET. Consequence: for live calls, arm B and arm A are the same prompt, and the metadata layer's contribution to production today is structurally zero — independent of any experiment.
live_voice_path.batch_path_note: The BATCH path is different and is why this ablation can run at all: /api/models/transcribe calls whissle_batch_metadata in parallel with the external transcription, and that head IS serving in production. It is fail-open, so a timeout simply omits the `metadata` key.

structural_audit.headline: Of 8 cascade channels, 2 (emotion, intent) reach the model at all; the rest are produced and discarded. On the live voice path none of them reach it, because the head that produces them is not running there.
